subject.title: fix: preserve BOOTSTRAP.md in preseeded workspaces (#91931)

question: Should OpenClaw universally treat an existing `BOOTSTRAP.md` with no `setupCompletedAt` as pending unless durable non-skill user content exists, even for legacy workspaces that previously used profile-only stale-bootstrap recovery?
rationale: The code cannot distinguish a platform-preseeded profile from a user-customized legacy profile, and the branch intentionally selects one compatibility behavior for both cases.

options.title: Confirm the universal pending-bootstrap rule
options.body: Keep the branch’s rule, document the changed recovery semantics, and require current-state live proof before merge.

options.title: Preserve legacy profile-only recovery
options.body: Revise the design to retain the existing recovery behavior through a clearly defined compatibility boundary rather than changing it unconditionally.

recommendation.title: Confirm the universal pending-bootstrap rule
recommendation.body: Keep the branch’s rule, document the changed recovery semantics, and require current-state live proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The available evidence does not establish a specific current-main workspace/bootstrap owner; this requires the responsible product/code owner rather than the external reporter.
